results.name: Financial strength
results.label: pass
results.threshold: long-term debt <= 2 x stockholders' equity (utility variant)

results.name: Earnings stability
results.label: pass
results.threshold: net income > 0 in every year of the last 10

results.name: Dividend record
results.label: partial_pass
results.threshold: dividend paid in every year on record in the last 15

results.name: Earnings growth
results.label: pass
results.threshold: 3-yr avg diluted EPS (end) >= 1.33 x 3-yr avg (start of the 10-yr window)

results.name: Moderate P/E
results.label: data_gap
results.threshold: price <= 15 x avg diluted EPS of the last 3 years

results.name: Return on equity
results.label: fail
results.threshold: ROE >= 15% in at least 7 of the last 10 years

results.name: Conservative debt
results.label: fail
results.threshold: long-term debt <= 4 x avg net income of the last 3 years

results.name: Stable margins
results.label: pass
results.threshold: operating margin > 0 every year and last-3-yr avg >= 90% of the 10-yr avg

results.name: Owner earnings
results.label: fail
results.threshold: net income + D&A - capex > 0 in >= 8 of 10 years and last-3-yr avg > first-3-yr avg
